Game Overview

In King Rathor, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a heroic rescue mission as King Rathor, braving treacherous terrains and cunning foes. Utilize agile maneuvers and precise double jumps to navigate perilous challenges. Each level demands strategic timing and swift reflexes, making every moment thrilling. Can you rescue the queen and claim victory?
